events.name: Bash
events.head: Check probes, card content, dev server
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls app/scripts/probe-workshop.mjs app/scripts/probe-funnels.mjs scripts/probe-logos.mjs 2>&1; grep -n "19M\|endCX\|Rhenus\|SalesTherapy" app/src/components/masterclass/receipts.tsx | head; grep -n "RATIO\|rhenus\|salestherapy" -i app/src/components/masterclass/logos.tsx | head; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P | grep -i node | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate logo probe, server, and PNG alpha
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls scripts/ app/scripts | grep -i logo; head -30 app/scripts/probe-workshop.mjs | grep -n "BASE\|localhost\|http" ; head -30 app/scripts/probe-funnels.mjs | grep -n "BASE\|localhost\|http"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/masterclass; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find probe base URLs and running servers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -n "BASE\|localhost" scripts/probe-workshop.mjs scripts/probe-logos.mjs | head; grep -n '"dev"\|"start"' package.json; for p in 3000 3001 4322 4399 5173; do echo $p $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:$p/); done

events.text: A server is running on 4322. Running all three probes against it.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run logo probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; export BASE=http://localhost:4322; (node scripts/probe-logos.mjs > /tmp/t011-logos.txt 2>&1; echo "logos exit $?" >> /tmp/t011-logos.txt) ; tail -15 /tmp/t011-logos.txt

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect probe logic and logo sizing
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; cat /tmp/t011-logos.txt | head -20; sed -n 1,80p scripts/probe-logos.mjs; sed -n 25,110p src/components/masterclass/logos.tsx; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: See probe output detail and receipts usage
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; sed -n 80,120p scripts/probe-logos.mjs; grep -n "LogoMark\|logoBox\|nominal" src/components/masterclass/receipts.tsx | head -20; grep -n "kadima" -r src | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Trace tiers in receipts and history
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; git log -L454,454:src/components/masterclass/receipts.tsx --format="%h %ad %s" --date=short -s | head -5; git log --format="%h %ad %s" --date=short -3 -- scripts/probe-logos.mjs; sed -n 255,300p src/components/masterclass/receipts.tsx; sed -n 440,460p src/components/masterclass/receipts.tsx

events.text: Logo probe passes. Now the workshop and funnels probes, plus a 3-width visual check of the proof cards.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run workshop and funnel probes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; (BASE=http://localhost:4322 node scripts/probe-workshop.mjs > /tmp/t011-ws.txt 2>&1; echo "exit $?" >> /tmp/t011-ws.txt) & (BASE=http://localhost:4322 node scripts/probe-funnels.mjs > /tmp/t011-fn.txt 2>&1; echo "exit $?" >> /tmp/t011-fn.txt) & wait; echo WS; grep -ciE "fail|✗" /tmp/t011-ws.txt; tail -6 /tmp/t011-ws.txt; echo FN; grep -ciE "fail|✗" /tmp/t011-fn.txt; tail -6 /tmp/t011-fn.txt
